newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles County prepares $1.3 bln note deal.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles County prepares $1.3 bln note deal.

text.p: Los Angeles County plans to issue $1.3 billion of tax-exempt tax and revenue anticipation notes on June 16 or 17, a county finance official said Thursday.
Maureen Sicotte, the county's director of finance and investments, said the senior underwriter for the notes would be Merrill Lynch & Co.
She said the county may seek a letter of credit for the notes, depending on market conditions in June.
The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors will consider the bond issue next week.
County officials will travel to New York to meet with the major credit rating agencies on June 5 to discuss the county's budget and bonding plans.
Last year, the county issued $1.05 billion of tax and revenue anticipation notes.
